evaluation_adapter_v2.supersedes: r66_eval_fixed.py (v1) is preserved unchanged at 7e8014f; v2 is a new file and a new row namespace, never an edit of the committed v1

seams.E1: reserve ceiling is booked 39, not the inherited 40, and the D1 +1 unregistered environment construction is counted inside the 1150 hard cap
seams.E2: an incomplete / already-run / unreadable prior attempt is never reused; the retry takes the next attempt number in the RESERVE category with an attempt-isolated run tag, and the original claim, row and log survive byte-identical
seams.E3: a single generator eval_job_order() drives both the plan and the executor loops; planned_normal_slot is declared a plan enumeration, not a binding, because the real number comes from r40_common._reserve_slot lowest-free; _assert_visited_order proves the executor visited every planned cell in exactly the planned order
seams.E4: a complete claim is admissible only with a sound durable receipt: row path, row sha256, companions with path/sha256/bytes, re-hashed and re-read, plus row identity; the same test gates _prepare_claim so an unsound complete claim cannot deadlock a cell
seams.E5: the row and its receipt are persisted and re-verified BEFORE finish_launch(ok=True); a failing row write leaves failed_technical and never complete
seams.E6: target-set differences are paired per (scene, target_id) and never merged, so a same-named target in two scenes cannot cancel
seams.E7: the on-time target set is rebuilt from task_reward_events and closed in two ways against row['on_time']; anything unreadable or inconsistent raises
seams.E7b: a legitimate zero-task row (empty or absent event list with on_time == 0) closes to the empty set; emptiness alone is never treated as a data error
seams.E8: every row entering the statistics is named by a complete claim whose receipt re-proves from disk; an orphan row left by a failed retry is excluded and reported, never chosen by glob order; two sound receipts for one logical job are refused as ambiguous; a receipted row whose own identity contradicts its claim is refused
